newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens gains after analyst briefing.
newsitem.headline: Siemens gains after analyst briefing.

text.p: Shares in German industrial group Siemens AG on Friday climbed 3.5 percent in pre-bourse electronic trading, lifted by a postive outlook presented to analysts the day before, traders said.
Siemens shares traded at an all-time high of 125.90 marks, up 4.40 marks from its Thursday close, outpacing the DAX, which was up less than one percent at 4,358.47 at 0930 GMT.
Siemens on Monday said net income in the nine months to June 30 rose three percent to 1.705 billion marks. Previously it had expected no improvement in 1996/97 earnings.
